Scoped original institutional usage is evidence of terminology, not broad population recognition or enjoyment. Zero actual selection/play means no accepted player improvement is established.

A context witness does not erase church-cantor/mentor/register senses or establish unrestricted dominant equivalence. The attributed third-party dictionary is correctly distinguished from original-publisher provenance; no grammatical family, wholesale synonyms or alias ownership changes are approved.

Historical BCR product-function evidence is expressly narrow and dated, not present advice, current rollout or universal physical-card requirement. Missing Bancomat/Card bancar owners block an existing-node-only direction; introducing two mutually related hypotheses does not independently earn distinctive4/2sets. Generic bank/money fan-out would not prove specific useful associations.

Exact n_v2art_teatru describes dramatic/scenic art, not an institution/building. The proposed uniform institution framing therefore mismatches its owner even though the word has other everyday senses. Bibliotecă–Carte already appears as exact served pair vp_d4de16f5c5ae3db873a0; absence of three other exact pair duplicates is insufficient to count four fresh associations. Museums can contain more than paintings and public performances need not be theatre; competing matches remain unreviewed. Preserve rejection without category-moving Teatru or relabeling an old board.

National Library page supports consultation and qualifies home borrowing through its named exception; this cannot become a universal lending claim. Reading directions already have bidirectional de4073/de5755 and earn zero fresh direction credit. Existing arcs and tombstone owner occurrences stay preserved.

Four fresh lead hypotheses across three directions resolve to three holds and one exact-sketch rejection. None is researched-ready, selected or installed. Bounded identity scans are not complete semantic/history/gameplay clearance. Source5/operator/materialization/native/source/export/authority/history/assembled gates remain HELD NOT RUN.
